title: Apertus 1.5 adds images, reasoning and a 262K context window to fully open models
friendlyTitle: Apertus makes its open AI models better with images and longer memory
summary: Apertus released updated 8B and 70B models with native image understanding, an optional thinking mode, stronger tool use and a fourfold context increase to 262,144 tokens. The project continues to publish weights, data, values and training details, although a fuller technical report is still forthcoming.
friendlySummary: Apertus updated its 8B and 70B open models. They can understand images, think before answering, use tools better and read much longer inputs.
whyItMatters: Teams that need inspectable or sovereign AI gain a more capable multimodal option without giving up model transparency. The 8B version may also make experimentation practical on more modest infrastructure.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This gives people and businesses a more useful AI model that they can inspect and control themselves. The smaller model may be easier and cheaper to test.
